Technical Documentation Engine 1.0.0 — initial release

- Provides a complete, structured system for technical documentation covering architecture decisions, API references, runbooks, changelogs, and docs-as-code workflows.
- Includes actionable frameworks: documentation audit scorecard, quick wins checklist, and best-practice templates for README, ADR, and API docs.
- Emphasizes real examples, maintainability, onboarding speed, and reducing support overhead.
- Clear rules and checklists ensure documentation remains useful, up-to-date, and trusted by developers.
